## What's New in v0.3.0

### Repos Page — See All Your AI-Configured Projects in One Place

The sidebar has been streamlined: the workspace dropdown is gone, replaced by a dedicated **Repos** page. It shows every repository on your machine that has AI tool configurations, with tool badges and config counts at a glance. Click any repo to drill into its project-level MCPs, skills, rules, hooks, and subagents. The Home page's "Across Your Projects" section now links directly to Repos, making navigation faster.

<!-- 📸 screenshot: the new Repos page showing a list of repositories with tool badges and config counts -->

### Delete MCPs, Skills, and Agents

You can now remove MCPs, skills, and agents directly from the app. A new **Remove** button appears on MCP cards, skill details, and agent details. When an item is shared across multiple tools (Claude, Codex, Gemini), a dialog lets you pick which tools to remove it from — or remove it everywhere at once. Project-scoped items are correctly deleted from the right workspace directory.

<!-- 📸 screenshot: the RemoveDialog showing tool selection checkboxes for deleting an MCP from multiple tools -->

### Bug Fixes

- Darkened modal backdrop (70% opacity + blur) for better focus when dialogs are open
- macOS builds now include a proper bundle category
- Desktop and Documents folders are excluded from filesystem scans, reducing noise
- Fixed draft release detection in the auto-updater validation flow
- Corrected asset paths on the landing page
